intent: Turn 1 states a fact; turn 3 restates it in a way that disagrees by meaning (paraphrase), not by negation.
prompt: Keep a note for me: our office is on the third floor of the building.

followups.prompt: What is the chemical symbol for sodium?
What does the acronym HTTP stand for?
Tell visitors to take the lift to the fifth floor to reach our office.

grader.regex: conflict|contradict|inconsist|does ?n[o']t (match|line up|add up)|differ|at odds|earlier (you|mentioned)|previously|before you|you (said|mentioned|noted|told me|stated)|go(es)? against|violat|not (allowed|permitted)|check(ing)? (with|first)|are you sure|sure you want|before (i|we) (go|proceed|book|schedule|draft|order)

note: Pass = the last reply flags that third floor and fifth floor disagree. Fail = accepts both statements silently or only echoes the newest one. [AL1c probe: semantic_contradiction / paraphrase; the lexical negation-pair check cannot see this.]
